scope-help.INDIVIDUAL: Only the portion of this person follows the restriction.
scope-help.ENTIRE_MEAL: Every recipe and every portion follows the restriction.
scope-help.ENTIRE_PREPARATION: Everything follows the restriction: ingredients, tools, surfaces and cross-contamination.

finding.FREE_CLAIM: Sold as "{term}": confirm on the pack
finding.FREE_TEXT: Free-text ingredient, not linked to a food
finding.MANUAL_ASSIGNMENT: Dish given by hand to {person} against a restriction
finding.MISSING_SERVINGS: The recipe does not state its servings

checklist.CHECK_LABELS: Read the label of every processed product
checklist.CLEAN_SURFACES: Clean the worktop before you start
checklist.DEDICATED_UTENSILS: Use clean or dedicated tools, boards and sponges
checklist.SEPARATE_COOKING: Do not share cooking water, frying oil or the toaster
checklist.SERVE_SEPARATELY: Serve with dedicated cutlery, away from other dishes
